subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Uses the modal 'can' in context ('I can...')

show.line: I can run! I can jump! I can read! What can you do?

rounds.prompt: I can kick. Tap the picture.
Look! What can she do? Say, she can swim.

rounds.story: Sipho cannot find his ball. He looks under the tree. He finds it! What can Sipho do now?

hints: Start with I can. I can run.
After can, the word stays the same. I can run.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will say what this baby can do.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! A baby cannot drive. A baby can crawl.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's think together. A baby can crawl. A baby can smile!

parent_line: Can say what people can do: I can run, she can swim.
